projects.title: Junoon - Ilm
projects.description: Junoon-Ilm is a minimalist, ultra-fast, developer-oriented personal educational command center and knowledge vault. It organizes links, notes, research papers, lecture series, and GitHub repositories across Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Distributed Systems, Computer Science fundamentals, and engineering projects.

projects.title: Opportunist
projects.description: Opportunist is a premium, high-contrast Forex Arbitrage Terminal designed to detect negative cycles in currency exchange rates and highlight risk-free profitable loops. It implements the Bellman-Ford Algorithm over log-transformed rates to transform triangular and polygonal trades into negative sum cycles.

projects.title: Investigo
projects.description: Investigo is an autonomous, multi-agent AI research platform designed to automate deep information gathering, synthesis, and publication-grade report compilation. Given a single research query, Investigo decomposes the topic into distinct sub-topics, conducts parallel web searches, normalizes findings using distributed LLM agents, and compiles a comprehensive, academic-grade Markdown and PDF research dossier.

projects.title: unClutter
projects.description: An AI-powered document organization system that automatically clusters and categorizes files using semantic similarity, enabling intelligent and efficient document management.

projects.title: Tehqeeq.AI
projects.description: An AI-powered Text-to-SQL application that translates natural language questions into SQL queries and retrieves accurate, structured insights from relational databases using vector embeddings and large language models.
